name: Elderberryzzz - Balance 1g PLUS Vape Device — BREEZE Canna
description:
Embrace tranquil evenings with Elderberryzzz, a sophisticated Balance blend featuring rich elderberry enhanced with soothing CBN for restful relaxation. 

This premium formulation combines full-spectrum cannabinoids, including 20% CBD, with naturally derived terpenes to create a serene nighttime experience. 

Enhanced with myrcene, limonene, and beta caryophyllene, this expertly crafted blend delivers a luscious combination of juicy dark berries, bright citrus, and earthy notes that sets the stage for peaceful rest.
